claims: NATO is a political and military alliance.
NATO was established to guarantee the freedom and security of its members through collective defense.
NATO comprises 32 countries from Europe and North America.
NATO's Article 5 dictates that an attack against one member is an attack against all.
Article 5 is the foundation of the NATO alliance.
Article 5 promises mutual aid if a member is attacked.
NATO was founded to deter Soviet expansionism after WWII.
NATO now addresses modern security threats, including terrorism and regional instability.
As of 2024, NATO has 32 member countries.
NATO's member countries include the U.S., Canada, and most of Europe.
NATO members commit to investing in their own defense.
NATO members have a target of 5% of GDP annually on defence and security-related spending by 2035.
NATO's political headquarters are located in Brussels, Belgium.
NATO has the largest combined defense force in the world.
